market_note: GENIUS Act stablecoin rulemaking deadline landed July 18, forcing six federal agencies to finalize capital, reserve, and licensing rules for USDC/USAT issuers.

stablecoin_items.headline: GENIUS Act rules finalized
stablecoin_items.summary: Six federal agencies finalized capital, reserve, and licensing rules for stablecoin issuers; OCC set a $5M capital floor and FDIC confirmed no deposit insurance for token holders.

stablecoin_items.headline: Treasury warns of $6.6T deposit flight risk
stablecoin_items.summary: Treasury estimates yield-bearing stablecoins could pull up to $6.6 trillion from bank deposits, which legacy institutions call an existential threat to fractional-reserve banking.

stablecoin_items.headline: Visa launches bank stablecoin platform
stablecoin_items.summary: Visa unveiled a platform letting banks and fintechs issue, move, and manage stablecoins, broadening its crypto push as adoption widens.

stablecoin_items.headline: EU MiCA transition period ends
stablecoin_items.summary: The EU's MiCA transitional period closed July 1, requiring every crypto-asset service provider in the bloc to secure full authorization or shut down.

hack_items.headline: AFX Trade bridge exploit: $24M
hack_items.summary: An AFX-powered bridge on Arbitrum was drained of about $24.15M in USDC on July 22; the attacker converted proceeds to ETH and consolidated in one wallet.

hack_items.headline: Triple-A hot wallets drained: $9.7M
hack_items.summary: Payments firm Triple-A had hot wallets drained across TRON, Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum on July 25; the firm says customer funds were not affected.

hack_items.headline: Wanchain, Verus bridges hit same week
hack_items.summary: Bridge exploits at Wanchain and Verus, plus an Allbridge Core flash-loan drain and a B² Network staking contract seizure, pushed weekly hack losses past $47M.

hack_items.headline: Ostium oracle manipulation hack
hack_items.summary: Arbitrum-based perps exchange Ostium lost an estimated $18-24M after an attacker used a compromised price-oracle private key to push fake future-dated price reports.
